verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature and nothing about leaving Navan with a full copy of your data in open formats. The only related material is a partner-gated Expense REST API with retrieval endpoints, plus an MCP server for natural-language queries. Both are developer building blocks or adjacent query features, not a first-party export capability, and the API covers only the expense surface rather than all account data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
